newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela $315 mln bond for frigates - Matos.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela $315 mln bond for frigates - Matos.

text.p: A $315 million 10-year Eurobond, due to be roadshowed by key Venezuelan ministers next week, is to be used to buy naval frigates, Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said in a Finance Ministry release.
Markets have recently been awash of a possible Brady debt buyback by Venezuela.
Matos said: "during the roadshow, I'll also take the opportunity to tell investors of the second phase of Venezuelan Agenda... people want to know how we have managed the oil bonanza."

The value of Venezuelan oil exports soared last year by some $3.5 billion on a spike in international oil prices. But public sector wage increases and expensive but crucial labor reforms have subsequently jeopardized plans to save the windfall.
Planning Minister Teodoro Petkoff and Trade and Industry Minister Freddy Rojas Parra will also travel with Matos, the release added.
